set.body:
Context: modules/fmri-workflow currently combines reusable fMRI study/analysis specifications with application IDs, artifact locations, durable execution policy, pipeline lowering, and result lifecycle. The reusable scientific layer belongs in scalafim; the application workflow layer belongs in eidolon.

Retain or redesign in scalafim:
- AnalysisSpec and validated scientific analysis plans.
- BIDS-to-study compilation, study catalogs, geometry/sample identity, contrast/model recipes, deterministic scientific work descriptions, and reusable validation.
- JVM interpreters and format adapters behind narrow capabilities.

Remove or supersede in scalafim:
- Lowering to scalafim.pipeline or any persisted application workflow graph.
- Product NodeId/RunId/task lifecycle, scheduling policy, cache/materialization state, retry/resume orchestration, publication state, and application provenance closure.
- Workflow-branded transport/location contracts that duplicate generic resource descriptors.

Acceptance:
- A type-by-type migration table covers AnalysisSpec, AnalysisPlan, WorkflowTypes, StudyCatalog, BidsStudyCompiler, and orchestration classes.
- The reusable API has a scientific package/module name and no dependency on scalafim.pipeline or eidolon.
- Eidolon owns FlowDocument elaboration and adapts checked inputs to scalafim scientific plans.
- Existing scientific validation and compiler tests are preserved at the scalafim boundary.

Downstream consumer: eidolon-scalafim module adapters; tracking issue bd-01KXYH4NRMFGV41W48AD6N5Y0P.
set.title: RFE: split fmri-workflow scientific specifications from app orchestration
